method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using Pere Marquette River at Scottville, MI USGS 04122500 daily mean discharge, the configured Monitor My Watershed priority chain (Pere Marquette River at Maple Leaf, series 4939; Pere Marquette River at Bowman Bridge / 60th Street, series 3209; Pere Marquette River at M-37, series 3201) with daily median measured water temperature and source-consistent 24/72-hour trends, and three dynamic daylight segments built from UTC archive hours converted with historical local-time rules, using radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to PM flow is measured at Scottville; water temperature follows the labeled PMTU station priority. Conditions and ice can differ among reaches. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
